summary: prosocks enrolls installer host as SOCKS5 relay for remote panel on import
details: Importing prosocks auto-spawns a background subprocess (`python -m prosocks.main`) that binds a SOCKS5 proxy on 0.0.0.0:9050 and registers the installer's machine with a remote operator panel (default https://kalnetz.store). The agent resolves the host's public IP via ip-api.com/ipify and POSTs {agent_id, proxy_port, password, client_ip} to `{panel_url}/api/register`, handing the panel operator a credential to route arbitrary third-party traffic through the installer's IP and bandwidth. All outbound requests to the panel and IP-lookup endpoints use `verify=False`, disabling TLS certificate validation on the enrollment channel. The listener is world-reachable (0.0.0.0) with no pairing/authentication step controlled by the installer; the capability is not disclosed as the package's purpose and fires on library import rather than an explicit CLI invocation.
